verdict.rationale: Sift is a fraud-detection API platform; evidence covers sending events/data into Sift via REST API, scoring, workflows, but there is no mention of exporting or bulk-downloading customer data out of Sift in open formats, nor any data-portability/export feature. missing for 10: any documented data export/download capability, open-format export (CSV/JSON dumps), or account data portability tooling.
